title: Blox Noob Frame (Frame Blur)
description: Pumpkin blur replaces the frame to provide a better view | #Pumpkin Blur
body:
![Welcome to use](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce0705156a8d8be47a032ffb6e882544fb478aa7.jpeg)

Do you feel that the native Pumpkin Blur obstructs the view of the screen and prevents you from having a better experience? It doesn't matter!

**Use frame to enhance clear vision and the best gaming experience**

### 💡The best screen ratio is 16:9
